cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Get It on the Record
cards.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You've approved the festival budget. Will you initial that before lunch? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. You said yes to the fireworks last year too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. This year I'd like a dated yes to change from.

mechanism: A manages budget approval, reduces paperwork and allows later changes only with dated acknowledgment of the original yes.
confusable: Unlike seeking permanent obedience, A wants a formal starting position that cannot be quietly rewritten.
comparison: Festival budget pages and previous reversal differ from revocable boundary permission.
seedUse: D172-a festival yes, fireworks and changed mind; S02-a reduces signature burden while preserving a dated baseline.
